name: Sales Report - per Customer
query:
SELECT
    dn.customer AS 'Customer:Link/Customer:',
    dn.currency AS 'Ccy',
    SUM(dn.total) AS "Amount:Currency/ccy:",
    SUM(dn.total_taxes_and_charges) AS "Tax:Currency/ccy:",
    SUM(dn.discount_amount) AS 'Disc:Currency/ccy:',
    SUM(dn.grand_total) AS "Total:Currency/ccy:"
FROM
    `tabDelivery Note` dn
WHERE
    dn.docstatus = 1
    AND dn.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
GROUP BY
    dn.customer, dn.currency
ORDER BY
    SUM(dn.grand_total) DESC; -- Diurutkan berdasarkan total penjualan tertinggi (opsional)
